show.description:
A village girl comes to the city, unaware she is the lost heir to a powerful billionaire family.
Her stepsister steals her identity and takes her place as the rich man’s daughter and her old lover's fiancée.
As she struggles as a worker in a hotel owned by her old lover, will the truth come out before she loses everything meant for her?
